result.rationale: PROOF_STEP::0 explicitly performs the flawed extension—extending φ by fixing Y pointwise—without verifying this is consistent with linear relations in H, which is exactly the annotated defect.

Both identify that extending φ by fixing Y can redefine φ on span{x_i}, since span(Y) may intersect/contain L, invalidating the extension—same root cause: insufficient independence between Y and {x_i}.
